candidates.review_note: The kth opening bracket contributes one depth unit iff at least k closing brackets follow it. At each fixed or forced opening, the relevant unknown-count inequality transforms into a binomial upper tail over left closes plus right closes. Precompute the two tail arrays for all unknowns and one forced unknown, then sum each opening contribution exactly once.

An optimal four-point polygon uses extreme points; for a hull with at least four vertices, fix a diagonal and maximize triangle area independently on its two sides using monotone calipers. For a triangular hull, insert the fourth point on the edge that sacrifices the smallest triangle. Collinear inputs have zero area.

Compress the route to endpoints and shrine vertices using directed shortest-path distances. For a proposed maximum shrine-free stretch, retain compressed arcs of at most that length and test whether their shortest total route fits the overall time limit. Binary search finite arc lengths; intermediate shrines along a compressed shortest path only improve the stretch bound.

Follow the literal recursive square construction and count containment inclusively. All descendants of a size-k center lie within coordinate distance less than2k, so prune branches outside that enclosing box. Format each answer right-aligned in width3.
